messages:
incident-bot: [ALERT] region-us-west-2: gpu-serving-pool queue length > 1200, avg wait 45s, error-rate +4.7% — autoscaler hit max_nodes in nodepool:gpu-pool-usw2 (max=48)
SRE Oncall: paging in. i'm on it, heading into triage. looks like queue spike from a single tenant?
Alex: confirmed high q for /v1/generate on prod-us-west, tenant: sandbox-xyz but spillover to shared pool. latency dashboard: https://console.redwood/in/metrics/queue?pool=gpu-pool-usw2
Priya: autoscaler events: 
```
Warning  FailedScaleUp  2m (x5 over 3m) cluster-autoscaler  max nodes reached for nodegroup/gpu-pool-usw2 (min=4 max=48)
```
Carlos: pods pending: 42 PendingReason=Unschedulable: Insufficient GPUs. HPA is not the issue; cluster cap is.
SRE Oncall: quick mitigations: 1) reduce model batch_size via runtime flag on in-flight host routes 2) route heavy tenants to eu region fallback 3) request emergency nodepool bump to infra.
Maria-CS: customer impact: 2 paying tenants (alpha-fin and chatflow) reported slow responses; we have active support tickets P2 for alpha-fin. need ETA.
Priya: trying staged change: set runtime override "batch_size": 1 for heavy model routes (will increase qps but reduce GPU occupancy). applying via console now.
Alex: applying route override: `curl -X POST https://api.redwood/v1/routes/override -d '{"route":"/v1/generate","batch_size":1,"target_tenants":["sandbox-xyz","alpha-fin"]}'` — monitor.
deploy-bot: deploy started: route-override-v1 by Priya at 1733337152
SRE Oncall: batch_size override live. preliminary numbers: avg gpu utilization down 18%, queue growth slowed but still trending up.
Carlos: still 30 pods pending. autoscaler tip: nodepool created with taints: gpu=true:NoSchedule; new node add needs quota from infra (we're at regional GPU quota).
Infra Lead: I'm pulling quota info. we have spare quota in eu-west but region-us-west2 exhausted due to a recent Dedicated customer onboarding. can request emergency quota but standard approval takes 30-60m.
SRE Oncall: can we do a temporary cross-region routing policy to send sandbox-xyz to eu? what about data residency?
Alex: sandbox-xyz flagged as non-production, safe to route to eu for now. chatflow and alpha-fin are production — need CS approval before routing.
Maria-CS: alpha-fin explicitly requires us-west for latency SLAs. they prefer no cross-region. we should avoid routing them. chatflow ok to route.
Priya: alternate mitigation: spin up smaller-gpu model variant (fp16-quant) in same region which fits on existing nodes. preparing a quick model variant rollout for heavy tenants.
Carlos: image ready, pushing variant to registry, will stage on warm nodes. might take ~5m to pull and warm caches.
Infra Lead: trying emergency quota request with cloud provider: Requesting +12 GPUs to us-west2, reason: production incident, expected duration 2h. filing ticket #INC-9876 with cloud support.
SRE Oncall: status check in 5m. if quota doesn't appear we will escalate to Eng Director for manual approval to temporarily increase cluster max nodes (we have infra policy to allow manual bump for incidents).
Alex: manual kube resize command prepared if approval granted: `gcloud container clusters resize redwood-prod --node-pool gpu-pool-usw2 --num-nodes 60 --region us-west2` (will trigger cloud API quota check).
Infra Lead: cloud support acknowledged ticket, estimated 18-28 minutes for quota approval. will update.
Priya: model-variant rollout started for chatflow and sandbox-xyz -> variant-fp16-quant. route-level traffic split 80/20 initially.
deploy-bot: rollout 20% -> 80% in 3m by Priya at 1733337230
SRE Oncall: variant rollout reduced pending pods by 12, latency for chatflow improved ~22%. alpha-fin still slow.
Maria-CS: informing alpha-fin support contact about degraded performance and our mitigation plan. sending message: "we're working on capacity; temporary performance degradation expected ~30-60m" :email-sent:
Alex: cloud quota approved at 1733337320 (provider ticket INC-2024-389 ack). Infra lead: you have green light to proceed with manual node increase.
Infra Lead: manual approval granted by Eng Director. executing resize now.
Infra Lead: running: `gcloud container clusters resize redwood-prod --node-pool gpu-pool-usw2 --num-nodes 60 --region us-west2`
deploy-bot: resize job started at 1733337338
SRE Oncall: monitoring node join events.
Carlos: new nodes booting, kubelet register visible. pending pods decreasing.
SRE Oncall: nodes joined, autoscaler still at max but cluster now has 60 nodes. queue draining rate increased, error-rate returning to baseline.
Maria-CS: alpha-fin confirms improvement, reporting request latency back to acceptable range. they ask for postmortem.
SRE Oncall: incident resolved for now. next actions: 1) runbook update to clarify emergency quota process and escalation path 2) consider raising region max for gpu-pool-usw2 or prioritizing production tenants via routing policy 3) schedule capacity review with Platform team.
Alex: opening incident ticket INC-2024-3919 with notes, timeline, and follow-ups. assigning to Priya and Infra Lead.
Priya: will prepare playbook changes and test cross-region routing in staging.
Infra Lead: will request permanent quota increase for us-west2 and add an alert for nodepool nearing max_nodes.
SRE Oncall: handing off to day shift. tagging Ops Lead for follow-ups. thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
Alex: moving to post-incident review channel.
incident-bot: [RESOLVED] region-us-west-2: gpu-serving-pool queue normalized. incident duration ~12m.
